summary: The documents related to DestProfilePrfRequirements describe the implementation of a web user control for handling prerequisite requirements, such as standard, document, or link-based requirements, for a specific profile within the HSPnet application.
purpose: To manage and display prerequisite requirements for user profiles, allowing the addition, modification, and deletion of these requirements within the system.

workflows.name: Handling Prerequisite Requirements
steps: Load and display existing prerequisite requirements.
Allow users to add a new requirement or edit/delete an existing one.
Provide options for setting the requirement as a standard entry, a document upload, or a URL link.
Handle the file upload process and store information about the uploaded file in the system.
Display a list of disciplines and allow users to set requirements per discipline.
Provide validation and client-side scripting to ensure correct user input and data consistency.

business_rules: Do not process alternate databases when adding or editing requirements.
Omitted requirement codes should be removed from the data source before displaying options.
Hidden requirement types, such as document and URL, should be removed from the list.
validations: Ensure required fields have values before submission.
Client-side validation checks on requirement description.
conditions: If UseSubDisciplines is true, display sub-discipline selection options.
If ScreenIsEditable is true, show add/edit buttons in the UI.
system_behavior: Load and bind data to controls on page load.
Update view state and UI elements based on user actions.
Dynamically adjust UI based on the type of prerequisite selected (standard, document, link).
exceptions: Canceled operations if prerequisites are not loaded or user session is unavailable.
